headline: Mistral releases improved Mistral Large 4 weights with updated coding and cyber claims
summary: Mistral says it released an improved Mistral Large 4 checkpoint as open weights on Oct 29, following an Oct 6 public preview and three additional weeks of reinforcement learning. The model card lists a 1.05T-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 49B active parameters per token (52B including embeddings and output layers), and the checkpoint is listed on Hugging Face under a modified MIT-style license that requires a separate license for model-as-a-service businesses. Mistral reports updated coding, cybersecurity, finance and browsing results, including 48% on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index with 47% fewer tokens per task than its stated comparison, and 51% on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index. These are vendor-reported results; the full technical report is not yet available and no independent evaluation or local model run was conducted here.
